title: EMERGENCY PODCAST Ex-CIA Spy: World War III Has Already Started — Most People Just Don't Know It Yet
summary: A former CIA officer argues the 2026 US-Israeli war on Iran was driven by legacy and economics rather than a nuclear threat, and that World War 3 is already under way in a new, non-WWII form.

assertions.quote: I think World War III is already happening.
Iran very clearly in that document published in March of 2025 is not working on weapons of mass destruction.

verdicts.note: The ODNI's 2025 Annual Threat Assessment judged Iran was not building a nuclear weapon, while noting its enriched-uranium stockpile was at a record level.

assertions.quote: Plus the fact that we had representatives of the Trump administration saying that Iran was 5 days away from a nuclear weapon.
we have multiple pieces of evidence along the trail that suggest it wasn't about nuclear weapons

verdicts.note: The motives behind the decision to strike are not on the public record.

The paper says the war aimed to subdue Iran or topple its regime, yet the US terms put dismantling Iran's nuclear capabilities and ending enrichment first, so the nuclear programme was central but not the whole aim.

assertions.quote: they're not going to risk geopolitical blowback from all over the world
He can always say, "We're going to change that to 2029, folks.

verdicts.note: 2027 is a PLA readiness goal, not an invasion date, and forecasters put an invasion by the end of 2027 well below even odds.

assertions.quote: Chinese covert influence successfully turned the Congress, the the parliament of Taiwan into a majoritively pro unification

verdicts.note: The opposition majority came from Taiwan's 2024 election; the KMT favours engagement with Beijing, not unification, and support for unification in Taiwan remains small.

assertions.quote: the United States knows it's a declining power

verdicts.note: The US share of world output and its lead over China have narrowed, but it remains the leading military and financial power.
Only 7% expect the US to be the dominant power in 2036 and 58% expect China to lead economically, yet nearly three-quarters expect the US to remain the leading military power.
DDIS says China's growing influence has weakened the US position as the world's dominant power, leaving neither able to shape events alone; relative decline, not decline in absolute terms.

assertions.quote: You have more conflict in the world than we've seen in our genera- in our lifetime, for sure.
I don't think World War in the way people think about it is ever going to happen.

verdicts.note: A prediction about the form of a war that has not happened; recent wars mix drones, cyber and economic tools but remain heavily kinetic.

assertions.quote: if Iran were to close that for a meaningful period of time, basically a global recession is guaranteed.
Oh, Israel is the puppet master. Israel is controlling everything.

verdicts.note: Who drives decisions inside the US government is not on the public record.
